integrity: The characteristic and matrix identities were reconstructed using exact integer arithmetic from the embedded local transfer definition; independent spin enumerators checked n=4,5,6 and n=7. Finite checks are separate from the all-length proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the zero-field uniform classical three-state Potts antiferromagnet on ordinary Mycielskians of n-cycles for integer n>=4 is covered. The n=5 count is already known; the all-length parity law is the assessed result. General graph-polynomial methods implicitly encode the relevant coefficients, and unindexed historical tables or inaccessible manuscripts may cover the exact evaluated recurrence. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
title: Parity-dependent residual entropy of three-state Potts antiferromagnets on Mycielskian cycles
